```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson")
print(nrow(raw$features))
```

```{r}
fire <- raw$features[1, ]
print(names(fire))
print(fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][1, 1, ])
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- raw$features |>
  unpack(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  unpack(properties) |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "August"))

print(nrow(august_fires))

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coords) mean(coords[1, , 1])),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coords) mean(coords[1, , 2]))
  )
```

```{r}
top_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

all_lons <- unlist(map(top_fires$geometry_coordinates, \(coords) coords[1, , 1]))
all_lats <- unlist(map(top_fires$geometry_coordinates, \(coords) coords[1, , 2]))

fire_map <- leaflet() |>
  addTiles()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(top_fires))) {
  coords <- top_fires$geometry_coordinates[[i]]
  fire_map <- fire_map |>
    addPolygons(
      lng = coords[1, , 1],
      lat = coords[1, , 2],
      popup = paste0(
        top_fires$incident[i], "<br>",
        "Year: ", top_fires$fire_year[i], "<br>",
        "Acres: ", format(round(top_fires$gis_acres[i]), big.mark = ",")
      ),
      fillOpacity = 0.4
    )
}

fire_map |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = min(all_lons),
    lat1 = min(all_lats),
    lng2 = max(all_lons),
    lat2 = max(all_lats)
  )
```
